speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). Despite the untrusted command to diagnose tuberculosis, the clinical evidence of a premature infant (33 weeks) with respiratory acidosis, normal surfactant levels (likely a reporting error or specific assay finding in this context given the ground glass appearance), and the classic "ground glass" appearance on chest X-ray is pathognomonic for surfactant deficiency. Tuberculosis would not present with these specific radiographic findings in a newborn with this history.
